subject: Lighthouse priorities & role-rotation plan — QBR comms draft
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Lighthouse priorities & role-rotation plan — draft for QBR

Team,

I put together a short draft of the "Lighthouse" priorities slide and an accompanying role-rotation proposal to present at the QBR. The intent is twofold: 1) surface the handful of bets we want every product/infra/ops leader to align on for the next two quarters, and 2) propose a lightweight rotation/succession path for a couple of key steward roles so we can accelerate cross-pollination without broad reorg noise.

Attached: lighthouse_priorities_v1.pptx (slide deck), succession_matrix.xlsx (role-paths).

High-level asks:
- Can you review the slide titles and the three lighthouse bets (latency economics, model catalog hygiene, and deploy resilience)? I'm trying to keep this to one slide so execs get the point quickly.
- On the rotation matrix: recommend 2-quarter pilot; identify volunteers + backfills. Any red flags?

Goal: finalize by EOD Wednesday (14th) so Comms can fold the language into the QBR deck on Thursday.

Thanks — will take any edits inline.

Jordan
Jordan Blake | VP, Platform & Product Operations
Redwood Inference
(jordan@redwood.com)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse priorities & role-rotation plan — draft for QBR

Jordan —

Nice framing. A few quick notes after a pass:

- Slide: suggest renaming bet #2 to "Model catalog hygiene & deprecation cadence" — makes it clearer this is operational, not research.
- Add one bullet about "cost-per-inference guardrails" under latency economics (ops/finance coordination).
- Rotation: agree with 2-quarter pilot. For volunteers, I think Marcus (infra) and Tessa (dedicated) would be strong stewards; they have the bandwidth for a 6–9 month cross-pollination. If we propose them, we should confirm with their managers first.

I'll inline a few edits in the deck and push a version back.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Chief of Staff, Product

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-12T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse priorities & role-rotation plan — draft for QBR

Jordan / Soojin —

Good shape. My perspective: keep the slide tightly business-oriented — show the problem statement + expected QBR ask (e.g., "Approve 2-quarter rotation pilot" / "Endorse priority bets").

A few tactical changes:
- Swap the order to put deploy resilience first (it maps to customer SLAs we keep hearing about).
- On the succession matrix, remove granular titles — instead show roles + capabilities (e.g., "KV-caching steward" -> "KV cache ops lead") to avoid signaling headcount changes.

I'll add a short speaker note suggestion for the QBR script.

Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-13T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse priorities & role-rotation plan — draft for QBR

Quick thought from comms perspective:

- We should put an explicit "what we will not change" line to reduce rumor risk — e.g., no forced moves, rotations are pilots and voluntary, hiring plans unchanged.
- Add one slide with FAQ: timeline, impact on ongoing projects, manager approval process, and points of contact (Soojin + Jordan).

I'll draft the FAQ slide and a short leader-facing script. Attaching draft copy as a doc snippet inside the deck.

Marissa
Head of Corporate Comms

On attachments: referenced slides updated in the drive link.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-13T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lighthouse priorities & role-rotation plan — draft for QBR

Thanks — this is helpful. I pulled the edits into v2 and added the speaker notes Jonas suggested.

Before we lock: two operational asks.
1) Naomi — can you confirm whether the cost guardrails language maps to the new billing metric ("unit inference cost") we agreed with Finance? If yes, we'll include a brief metric definition in the notes.
2) Soojin — can you and Marissa run a quick alignment with Marcus and Tessa's managers to surface any capacity conflicts? I'd like volunteers identified by Tuesday EOD.

If we get those answers by Tuesday 5pm PT, I'll finalize the deck and loop Claire Morris from Clarity Comms for polish (she's doing the QBR design support).

Jordan

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Lighthouse priorities & role-rotation plan — draft for QBR

Jordan —

Confirmed: the "cost-per-inference guardrails" language aligns to the new "unit inference cost" (UIC) metric. I updated the notes to include the definition and a two-line example calculation, and added a pointer to the Finance FY28 playbook.

Also attached is a trimmed-down succession_matrix.xlsx that shows recommended shadow pairs and the proposed 8-week handoff checkpoints. No blockers from Finance' side; they'll add a green/red flag if any role materially impacts committed spend.

I'll upload the updated files to the Drive link and mark the deck as v2-final.

— Naomi
Head of Finance Strategy
